def format_price_range(low, high):
    def fmt(amount):
        cents = round(amount * 100)
        sign = '-' if cents < 0 else ''
        cents = abs(cents)
        dollars, rem = divmod(cents, 100)
        whole = str(dollars)
        groups = []
        while len(whole) > 3:
            groups.append(whole[-3:])
            whole = whole[:-3]
        groups.append(whole)
        with_commas = ','.join(reversed(groups))
        return f"{sign}${with_commas}.{rem:02d}"
    return f"{fmt(low)}-{fmt(high)}"

def count_specific_weekday_in_range(start_day_num, end_day_num, weekday):
    lo = start_day_num - weekday
    hi = end_day_num - weekday
    count = hi // 7 - (lo - 1) // 7
    return count
